AGENDA
  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  February 06, 2025

Meeting Place:  Call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900- 6833;
  Meeting ID: 863 5271 4337 and Password 295821

Call to Order:  2:00 p.m.

Roll Call

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any item on the agenda may
do so at this time.

Approval of the Minutes of the meeting held on January 28, 2025.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  Corey Breton on behalf of Cosm Hollywood Park LLC to host a Super Bowl at
  Cosm Event at 1252 District Dr., Private & Public Property, on Sunday, February
  09, 2025, from 10:00 a.m. – 10:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00404966)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Gabriel Soria on behalf of Northgate Market to host a Valentine’s Day Flower Sale
  Event at 10801 S Prairie Ave., Private Property, from Thursday, February 13, 2025
  to Friday, February 14, 2025, from 7:00 a.m. – 9:00 p.m. (Activity No. 00404953)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business
not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

Adjournment
